Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the query by deciding to use each film’s infobox “Country” (production country) as a proxy for the director’s country, conflating film country with director nationality. This led to comparing United States vs. Germany instead of the directors’ actual nationalities. Had the Planner checked the directors’ nationalities, they would have found both Curtis Bernhardt and Carl Boese are German, yielding the correct answer “yes.”
